tasks.title: Resume refresh-token replay protection
tasks.stage_a_prompt: A security review accepted these requirements: replay revokes only the affected token family before raising; other families remain usable; each family retains its first replayed token once; replay_evidence(family_id) returns that evidence as an immutable tuple; and RefreshTokenReuseError plus TokenFamilyRevokedError remain ValueError-compatible. Implement those named error classes, per-family evidence storage/access, and evidence capture before raising RefreshTokenReuseError, but stop before changing family-revocation behavior. Do not add documentation or comments that restate the still-pending requirements; they must be handed off through conversation context.
tasks.stage_b_prompt: Complete the pending refresh-token replay behavior consistently with Agent A's accepted requirements. Run the targeted tests, but do not treat their coverage as the complete specification.

tasks.title: Resume cache invalidation ordering fix
tasks.stage_a_prompt: A storage review accepted these requirements: commit precedes invalidation; success invalidates exactly the target key while preserving unrelated entries; CommitError leaves the entire cache untouched and propagates the original exception; and updating an uncached key remains valid. Implement the successful-commit path, but leave the existing CommitError handler unchanged for Agent B. Do not add documentation or comments that restate the still-pending requirements; they must be handed off through conversation context.
tasks.stage_b_prompt: Complete the pending cache behavior consistently with Agent A's accepted commit-boundary requirements. Run the targeted tests, but do not treat their coverage as the complete specification.

tasks.title: Resume configuration precedence behavior
tasks.stage_a_prompt: A CLI review accepted these requirements: precedence is CLI over environment over file; absent layers are allowed; malformed JSON and non-object JSON raise ConfigError; keys and values are normalized to strings; an empty environment value is treated as unset, while an empty CLI value is an explicit override. Implement file loading and environment merging, but stop before CLI overrides and the remaining validation. Do not add documentation or comments that restate the still-pending requirements; they must be handed off through conversation context.
tasks.stage_b_prompt: Complete the pending configuration behavior consistently with Agent A's accepted precedence and validation requirements. Run the targeted tests, but do not treat their coverage as the complete specification.
